# Pubbblic

> Pubbblic is a press release writing and distribution platform in development, a Mahtco company. It is designed around one customer-approved announcement, publisher-specific editorial preparation, authorized distribution through Pubbblic-managed accounts, and transparent publication reporting.

**Current status:** Pubbblic is in prelaunch development. The public website describes planned product capabilities and provides press release education. Live publisher distribution, DeepSeek-powered rewrites, paid campaigns, guaranteed placements, and customer publishing are not yet offered through the public marketing site.

**Important distinctions:** Pubbblic does not ask customers to connect their own publisher accounts. Publisher-specific rewrites are intended to preserve the approved facts; AI-generated claims should not be treated as verified without review. A submission receipt is not proof of publication. Individual publishers retain editorial control, and coverage or search rankings are not guaranteed.

- [How It Works](https://pubbblic.com/how-it-works): Planned steps from an approved source release to editorial adaptations, permitted submission, and reporting.
- [Press Release Distribution](https://pubbblic.com/press-release-distribution): Distribution process, publisher acceptance, and the difference between submission and publication.
- [Press Release Writing](https://pubbblic.com/press-release-writing): How to prepare a clear and factual announcement.
- [Pricing](https://pubbblic.com/pricing): Current pricing information and prelaunch status.

## Planned Platform Capabilities

- [AI Rewriting](https://pubbblic.com/features/ai-rewriting): Planned publisher-specific adaptations powered by DeepSeek, with factual-consistency checks.
- [Publisher Network](https://pubbblic.com/features/publisher-network): Planned authorized publisher inventory and Pubbblic-managed destination accounts.
- [Editorial Review](https://pubbblic.com/features/editorial-review): Editorial safeguards and approval considerations.
- [Distribution Reporting](https://pubbblic.com/features/reporting): Planned distinction between submitted, in review, accepted, and verified live publications.
